fact_levels.definition: A versioned, hash-bound fact emitted directly by the local production, publishing, or data-center system.
requirements: Bind the local source version and SHA-256.
Do not treat a local Stage 6 package state as a Publication Receipt.

fact_levels.definition: A value present in an authorized import, recorded response, or safe read of a publicly visible YouTube Data API field.
requirements: Bind collection time and raw response hash.
Never relabel public counts as CTR, retention, traffic, device, demographic, subscriber, or Studio facts.

fact_levels.definition: A value returned by YouTube Analytics or Reporting under separate channel-owner read authorization.
requirements: Bind authorized channel, query or report identity, data cutoff, and raw hash.
Keep upload authorization separate from Analytics authorization.

fact_levels.definition: A limited observation from an explicitly bounded content or comment sample, not a channel-wide measured fact.
requirements: Identify the sampled items and sample size.
Do not generalize beyond the observed sample.

fact_levels.definition: A falsifiable explanation derived from one or more bound facts but not established as causal truth.
requirements: State alternative explanations, confidence, and a verification action.

fact_levels.definition: The value is unavailable because the interface, permission, processing, threshold, sample, or completeness requirement is insufficient.
requirements: Record the reason for unknown status.
Never replace unknown, missing, delayed, or threshold-protected data with zero.

authorization_policy.token_boundary: Codex receives normalized data only and must not read or persist tokens, secrets, or OAuth client credentials.

source_capabilities.notes: Accepts authorized imports or a safe public-read adapter; this is not YouTube Studio or owner Analytics data. Synthetic fixtures remain synthetic facts in an isolated namespace.
Owner query capability is declared but unavailable until the user separately authorizes Analytics. No OAuth flow is started by this catalog.
Owner bulk-report capability is declared but unavailable until separately authorized; report IDs, createTime, coverage, and raw hashes must be retained for deduplication and revisions.
Reads only hash-bound upstream packages, production timeline maps, cost records, and statuses for the currently selected channel profile.

dimensions.definition: The registered YouTube video identity; formal data-center use requires a real Publication Receipt and video ID.
The offset-aware instant when a public response, owner response, bulk report, or local record was captured.
The official YouTube reporting calendar date associated with a row, distinct from collection time.
The ratio of elapsed video time used to locate an audience-retention measurement point.
The official category describing how viewers reached the video content.
The official category for the page or application in which video playback occurred.
The country associated with the activity row, represented by the source's official country code field.
The official category of device on which the viewing activity occurred.
The official category of operating system on which the viewing activity occurred.
Whether the viewer was subscribed to the channel at the time the measured activity occurred.
The source-supported content shape such as video on demand, Shorts, live stream, or other content.
An official aggregated viewer age range, usable only when owner data is returned with sufficient privacy protection.
An official aggregated viewer gender category, usable only when owner data is returned with sufficient privacy protection.
The ISO currency code bound to an explicitly recorded local optional cost or a separately authorized monetary metric.

metrics.definition: The publicly returned cumulative video view count at collection time; for Shorts the official counting rule differs beginning March 31, 2025.

timezone.notes: A cumulative observation, not a daily Studio window.

latency.official_guarantee: No fixed availability guarantee; YouTube may refine counts while processing.
latency.refresh_policy: Collect a new append-only observation at a scheduled checkpoint.

completeness.missing_behavior: MISSING or withheld data is UNKNOWN and must never be imputed as numeric zero.
completeness.zero_behavior: Zero is valid only when the source explicitly returned or the valid aggregation derived zero.

metrics.notes: This public counter must never be presented as impressions, CTR, watch time, retention, unique viewers, or a Studio owner metric.

metrics.definition: The publicly returned cumulative number of users who indicated that they liked the video at collection time.

timezone.notes: A cumulative observation, not a natural reporting day.

latency.official_guarantee: No fixed availability guarantee is documented for the public counter.
latency.refresh_policy: Collect a new append-only observation at a scheduled checkpoint.

completeness.missing_behavior: MISSING or withheld data is UNKNOWN and must never be imputed as numeric zero.

metrics.notes: Do not infer sentiment, viewer identity, or owner-only audience composition from this public count.

metrics.definition: The elapsed production duration calculated from hash-bound local timeline events for the registered project and video.

timezone.notes: Use monotonic elapsed time where available and retain event timestamps.

completeness.zero_behavior: Zero is valid only when the source explicitly returned or the valid aggregation derived zero.

metrics.definition: The number of locally recorded failed attempts that led to a retry for the bound production execution.

timezone.notes: Bind each retry event to the local execution timeline.

latency.official_guarantee: Available when the bound diagnostic record is committed.
latency.refresh_policy: Create a new normalized version only when the upstream diagnostic hash changes.

completeness.missing_behavior: MISSING or withheld data is UNKNOWN and must never be imputed as numeric zero.
completeness.zero_behavior: Zero is valid only when the source explicitly returned or the valid aggregation derived zero.

latency.refresh_policy: Create a new normalized version only when the upstream usage hash changes.

completeness.missing_behavior: MISSING or withheld data is UNKNOWN and must never be imputed as numeric zero.

metrics.definition: An optional explicitly recorded local production cost in currency microunits, separate from YouTube revenue.

timezone.notes: Cost is bound to the local execution and its recorded currency.

latency.refresh_policy: Create a new normalized version only when the upstream cost hash changes.

metrics.definition: The official estimated owner revenue metric, cataloged only to enforce the disabled monetary boundary in v1.

timezone.notes: This definition is inert while monetary access is disabled.
